name: jev
description: Jev picks the right GPT model and reasoning effort for every Codex task, from published benchmarks.

interface.shortDescription: Checks each new task: do model and Denkaufwand fit?
interface.longDescription: Type `#jev an` once in a conversation. Jev first decides itself whether a message is a new task; replies like "ok" are left alone. For a new task a fixed policy picks model and reasoning effort from published benchmarks and weighted user evidence. Fits: a check mark. One step off: one short line and a small Jev figure at the bottom right of the window (Windows). Two or more steps off: the message is held once; send it again to proceed. Switch in the model menu; Codex offers plugins no way to change it. `#jev status`, `#jev figur aus`, `#jev aus`. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY (Vercel AI Gateway); chat excerpts are sent to Jev and may incur charges.
